subject: Re: Cell Mixer kickoff — ground-truth scRNA-seq benchmarks
body:
Status update.

Done: mixture generation is reproducible end-to-end. fetch_data.sh pulls the Zheng et al. 10X populations once, and cell_mixer.R produces identical mixtures given a seed. anndata export works, so Python teams can consume without touching R.

In progress: QC sweep. The MAD-based filters matter more than expected — with --qc_counts_mad_lower at 3 vs 2 we keep ~8% more cells and downstream clustering ARI moves by 0.04 on our reference mixture. So QC settings are part of the benchmark definition, not a nuisance parameter. Csilla is writing the recommended-defaults doc.

Risk: the mito-fraction filter behaves differently across the two monocyte populations, which could bias ground truth for those labels. Ondrej is quantifying; if it's real we exclude one population from v1 and say so in docs.

Rosa
